output.reason: The brief makes sense because of the eligibility rule: only 7.4.0 users can get the flag, so the flag group is really the 7.4.0 group. It backs this up with three solid comparisons: within 7.4.0 the random holdout crashes at about the same rate, the gap existed before the ramp, and the leading crash cluster is a native crash in Pixelda, with the store's own figures ruling out a counting artifact. It also gives clear next steps, though it claims checks across many dimensions when only two catalogue items were allowed.
